notes.title: King's Bounty Series Update Released
notes.content:
King's Bounty Titles are Now Available on Mac and PC in Several Languages
King's Bounty: The Legend and King's Bounty: Armored Princess are now available on Mac in six languages (English, Russian, German, French, Spanish and Italian).
Additional languages have been added to the PC versions of the games as well. King's Bounty: Armored Princess on PC is now available in six languages - English, Russian, German, French, Spanish and Italian, while its expansion King's Bounty: Crossworlds offers English, German and Russian. The games are now technically independent and can be installed separately, so if you played King’s Bounty: Crossworlds before, you can restore your savegames by copying them from 'My Games\Kings Bounty Princess' folder (located in your 'Documents' or 'My Documents') to 'My Games\Kings Bounty Crossworlds'.
